{"CommandLine":"& "D:\CareBridge AI\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "
import urllib.request, json

# 1. Login as staff
req_login = urllib.request.Request(
    'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/auth/login',
    data=json.dumps({'email': 'staff@carebridge.ai', 'password': 'CareBridge#Staff2026!Admin'}).encode(),
    headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_login) as resp:
    login_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    token = login_data['access_token']
    print('[1] Staff Login SUCCESS: token acquired')

headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}

# 2. Test GET /api/patients
req_get = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients?page=1&limit=10&sort=newest', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_get) as resp:
    get_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print(f'[2] GET /api/patients: Total={get_data[\"total\"]}, Returned={len(get_data[\"patients\"])}, Stats={get_data[\"stats\"]}')

# 3. Test POST /api/patients with create_account
unique_phone = '9876549901'
unique_email = 'kavita.verma@carebridge.org'
payload = {
    'name': 'Kavita Verma',
    'phone': unique_phone,
    'email': unique_email,
    'age': 39,
    'gender': 'Female',
    'blood_group': 'A+',
    'allergies': 'Penicillin',
    'medical_history': 'Migraine, Asthma',
    'create_account': True
}

# Cleanup first if existing
req_cleanup = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients?search=Kavita', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_cleanup) as resp:
    existing_kavita = json.loads(resp.read().decode()).get('patients', [])
    for ek in existing_kavita:
        del_req = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients/{ek[\"_id\"]}', headers=headers, method='DELETE')
        try: urllib.request.urlopen(del_req)
        except: pass

req_post = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients', data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_post) as resp:
    post_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print(f'[3] POST /api/patients: Created ID={post_data[\"patientId\"]}, Temp Password={post_data[\"temp_password\"]}')
    new_patient_id = post_data['patient_id']

# 4. Verify new patient is at the top of list
req_get_new = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients?page=1&limit=5&sort=newest', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_get_new) as resp:
    get_new_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    first_p = get_new_data['patients'][0]
    print(f'[4] First Patient in List: Name={first_p[\"name\"]}, ID={first_p[\"patientId\"]}, Phone={first_p[\"phone\"]}')
    assert first_p['name'] == 'Kavita Verma', 'Newest patient should be first in newest sort'

# 5. Verify View Details GET
req_detail = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:5000/api/patients/{new_patient_id}', headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req_detail) as resp:
    detail_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print(f'[5] GET /api/patients/{new_patient_id}: Name={detail_data[\"name\"]}, Blood={detail_data[\"blood_group\"]}')

print('--- ALL END-TO-END TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY! ---')
